items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Ein Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats zu erheben; der Tag, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben wird, zählt dabei nicht mit.
items.computation: Letter dated (posting day) 02.04.2027, a Friday; no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the document date is taken as the posting day. Deemed delivery per § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO = 4th day after posting = 06.04.2027 (Tuesday) - not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, so for the Finanzamt (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO) no shift of the delivery day is needed. The one-month objection period under § 355 Abs. 1 AO / §§ 187, 188 BGB starts the next day (delivery day itself not counted) and ends on the day with the same number in the following month: 06.05.2027. That day, 06.05.2027, is Christi Himmelfahrt (Ascension Day), a nationwide public holiday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the period end moves to the next working day: 07.05.2027 (Friday), which is not itself a weekend or holiday.

warnings: The posting day was assumed to equal the printed document date (02.04.2027) because no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated in the letter; if the envelope was actually postmarked later, the deadline would shift accordingly.

The refund of 723,00 € will be paid to the bank account given in the original tax return; no new bank details are requested in this letter, and none should ever be provided in response to such a letter without verification.
